query:
INSERT INTO external_order_items
                (external_order_id, product_id, external_item_ref,
                 item_name_snapshot, qty, unit_price)
            VALUES (
                $1,
                (SELECT product_id FROM channel_listings
                  WHERE platform_id = $2 AND external_item_id = $3),
                $3, $4, $5, $6
            )
